summary: First-order exponential decay back to a baseline at rate τ⁻¹. Half-life ≈ 0.69 / τ⁻¹.

ranges.phrase: Fast decay — the half-life is short relative to the observed window; the system equilibrates quickly.
Moderate decay timescale — visible relaxation across the window.
Slow decay — the system retains memory of the initial state for many time units.
